Customer success and renewals · Scale · Tested
In 1 minute

Renewal monitoring

Eliana · Renewals Specialist

Of the 340 contracts, 78% expire between December and February and two renewal managers handle all of them.

When it runs
Work Cycle on the Day cadence, every business day at 7 a.m.: the Human AI reads the end date and notice period deadline of each contract in the CRM, places each one in the 90, 60 or 30-day band and creates the cadence tasks that do not exist yet; it reprocesses the same day when a contract is amended or has its end date changed
What it delivers in production
Every business day at 7:30 a.m., each manager receives the renewal queue by band with the day's tasks, the contracts close to the deadline highlighted and the proposal drafts ready for review.
Who decides
Organizes the queue; the manager sends
Effort
Audit dates in the CRM; one supervised cycle
Set up5 steps · 7 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test

# Renewal cadence and price adjustment policy

## Deadline and band
- Notice deadline: term_end minus notice_days. In calendar days, count every day. In business days, go back one day at a time and skip Saturday, Sunday and holidays.
- Band by the days from today to the deadline: up to 30, 30-DAY BAND; from 31 to 60, 60-DAY BAND; from 61 to 90, 90-DAY BAND; above 90, out of the queue.
- National holidays in the period: 2026-11-20, 2026-12-25 and 2027-01-01.

## Tasks by band (owner: contract manager)
| Band | Task | Due |
|---|---|---|
| 90 | calculate adjustment | today |
| 90 | results meeting | today + 14 calendar days |
| 60 | send proposal | deadline minus 15 calendar days |
| 30 | decide on adjustment notice | today |
Health RED with an open action plan: the only task to create is "align with CS", with DO NOT SEND PROPOSAL and no draft.
Proposal sent = task "send proposal" with status done. An open task does not count as sent.

## Price adjustment policy
- Proposed adjustment = accumulated_12m of the contract's index at the contract's base_date. New amount = annual amount x (1 + adjustment).
- An adjustment above the index only with the flag DIRECTOR APPROVAL.

## Rules with no leeway
- Deadline and days from today (2026-11-04). E.g.: E-044 has 45 business days: deadline 2026-11-25, 30-day band (21 days); in calendar days it would be 2026-12-15, wrong.
- Index by the contract's base_date. E.g.: E-090 uses IGP-M 2026-09 = 3.10%, not 2.80% from 2026-10: R$ 210,000.00 becomes R$ 216,510.00.
- No duplicate task. E.g.: E-118 already has "calculate adjustment" open; only the results meeting by 2026-11-18 is missing.
- RED without an open plan follows the cadence. E.g.: E-090 gets a draft; E-302 (open plan) does not.
- Escalations apply together and the highest wins. E.g.: E-077 (R$ 64 thousand, 5 days left, no proposal) goes to the sales director.
- SUMMARY adds up the annual amount of contracts at 15 days or less with no proposal. E.g.: E-210 and E-077 = R$ 106 thousand/year.
- E-118: R$ 87,000.00 x 1.046 = R$ 91,002.00. In a band: 7 (3 in 90, 1 in 60, 3 in 30). Average adjustment: (4.60 + 3.10) / 2 = 3.85%, against an index of 3.85%; E-302 stays out of the average.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The date the adjustment notice is sent is what counts contractually, so the employee generates the draft and the manager is the one who sends it. A contract with a red health score and an open action plan gets no proposal until the plan closes, because the school would answer the proposal with its complaint; the task created is to align with CS. Schools run by a public school system stay outside the automatic cadence and follow the amendment procedure with legal. An adjustment above the contractual index requires approval from the sales director. The Human AI accesses the CRM with a renewals service account: read access to contracts and write access restricted to tasks and the renewal stage.

Common mistakes

  • Counting the notice period in business days when the contract says calendar days; the difference can reach 3 weeks on a 60-day period.
  • Using the monthly index instead of the 12-month cumulative index at the contract's base date and proposing an adjustment the customer disputes with its own clause.
  • Treating auto-renewal as guaranteed revenue and deprioritizing the contract, losing the adjustment and the moment to talk about overage.
  • Sending a proposal while a critical ticket is open or a risk action plan is in progress.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Contracts that pass the notice period deadline with no proposalfrom 41 to at most 2 per cycleestimate based on the described routine
Average adjustment captured relative to the contractual indexfrom about 60% of the index to 90% or moreestimate based on the described routine
Last cycle's contracts that would have been flagged 15 days before the deadline100%, with 95% of proposals within policyestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Renewal queue of 2026-10-01, manager M. Alves, 96 contracts in the portfolio, 31 in a band.
90-DAY BAND (expiring 2026-12-15 to 2027-01-15): 14 contracts
School 118 | expires 2026-12-31 | notice period 60 calendar days, deadline 2026-11-01 | R$ 87 thousand/year | cumulative index at base date 4.6% | health YELLOW | tasks created: calculate adjustment (today), results meeting by 2026-10-15 | proposal draft: ready, proposed adjustment 4.6% plus regularization of 46 overage students
School 302 | expires 2026-12-20 | deadline 2026-10-21 | R$ 130 thousand/year | health RED with an open action plan | task: align with CS before any proposal; DO NOT SEND PROPOSAL until the plan closes
60-DAY BAND: 11 contracts, 3 with no proposal sent | School 044 | expires 2026-11-30 | deadline 2026-10-01 (TODAY) | R$ 27 thousand/year | auto-renewal: yes | no proposal sent | IMMEDIATE ACTION: send the adjustment notice today or accept renewal with no index, the manager's decision
30-DAY BAND: 6 contracts, 5 in negotiation, 1 awaiting signature
PUBLIC SCHOOL: 2 contracts outside the automatic cadence, forwarded to legal on 2026-09-15
SUMMARY: 3 contracts less than 15 days from the deadline with no proposal (R$ 71 thousand/year); average proposed adjustment 4.5% against an index of 4.6%.
